def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    unlevered_firm_value = 800000
    tax_rate = 0.28
    debt = 300000
    interest_rate = 0.05
    periods = 5

    # Do math calculation to get the answer
    annual_interest = debt * interest_rate
    annual_tax_shield = annual_interest * tax_rate
    pv_tax_shield = annual_tax_shield * (
        1 - (1 / (1 + interest_rate) ** periods)
    ) / interest_rate
    apv = unlevered_firm_value + pv_tax_shield

    # Return answer rounded to the nearest integer
    return round(apv)
